## What this changes

<!-- In plain words: what someone using the Music Room will notice. -->

## What kind of change

- [ ] A plug-in (in `plugins/`)
- [ ] A theme or a look
- [ ] A fix
- [ ] Something in the Music Room itself (say why it's needed)

## Before you send it

- [ ] I have read the [house rules](../HOUSE_RULES.md) and [how to help](../CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] It adds no music, pictures or words I don't have the rights to share.
- [ ] It holds no passwords, keys, account codes or anyone's personal details.
- [ ] A plug-in asks only for what it needs (`wants` in its `plugin.json`), and sends nothing anywhere.
- [ ] I ran the tests that touch what I changed (`./venv/bin/python test_….py`).
